senses.gloss:
अहोबल शास्त्रिन् or बोधानन्दघन guru of Rāmakṛṣṇa
(Mīmāṃsāsūtraprakāśikā). Hall p. 181.
बोधानन्दघन or अहोबल शास्त्रिन् q. v.

अहोबल disciple of Īśānendra and Nṛsiṃhendra:
 Puraścaraṇakaustubha. Bik. 600.

अहोबल son of Nṛsiṃhabhaṭṭa:
 Mahimnaḥstavaṭīkā. Oxf. 131^b.
 Rudrabhāṣya. IO. 2232. Oxf. 131^b. Oppert
3842.
 Saṃkalpasūryodayaṭīkā. Oppert II, 4207. 5800.

अहोबल सूरि
 Yājñikasarvasva Āpastambaśrautasūtrabhāṣya. He
quotes Rudradatta. Brl. 20.
अहोबल सूरि was son of Nṛsiṃha, grandson of Ahobala.

अहोबलनाथसिद्धान्त jy. by Ahobalanātha. Oppert II,
1946. 1947.
